No assertion checks that proration is explicitly tied to upgrade AND downgrade with a credit/charge computation. This run folds proration into CAP-03 (rather than a standalone capability); the current assertions pass for both arrangements, which is fine, but a content check on proration mechanics would be more discriminating.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are discriminating and pass cleanly. This run structures capabilities differently (proration inside lifecycle; a billing-portal capability added) yet still satisfies every assertion, showing the assertions are robust to reasonable structural variation.
